CALL TO ORDER

At 3:32 PM, Chair de Armas called the meeting to order.

ROLL CALL

Commissioners Present: Chiddick, Patterson, Woodman-Nance, Wheeler, de Armas

Commissioners Absent: Baca, Callihan

Also present: Rob Centeno, Deputy Director, Ryan Kurtzman, Technology Partnerships Officer,
Alejandra Garcia, Executive Assistant, Adam Jacobs, Deputy City Attorney, Karen Baldwin, City
Clerk Specialist.

ELECTION OF VICE CHAIR

A motion was made by Commissioner Woodman-Nance, to elect Commissioner Woodman-
Nance for Vice Chair of the Technology and Innovation Commission. The motion carried by
the following vote:

Yes:  5  Chiddick, Patterson, Woodman-Nance, Wheeler, de Armas
No:  0  None
Recused:  0  None
Abstain:  0  None
Absent:  2  Baca, Callihan

Chair de Armas declared the nominations open for Vice Chair.

Commissioner Woodman-Nance nominated Commissioner Woodman-Nance as Vice Chair of the
Technology and Innovation Commission.

 There being no further nominations, Chair de Armas declared the nominations closed for Vice Chair.

Commissioner Woodman-Nance accepted the Vice Chair of the Technology and Innovation
Commission nomination.
